Yes — as a US passport holder, you need a visa. The US has no visa-free exemption for Vietnam (no bilateral or unilateral agreement exists), so you'll need to get an e-Visa before you travel.

Key details:
- e-Visa allows stays of up to 90 days, so your 2-week trip is comfortably covered.
- Cost: $25 for a single-entry e-Visa or $50 for multiple-entry.
- Apply online at evisa.gov.vn; processing typically takes 2-3 business days (expedited options available for a higher fee).
- Valid for entry by air, land, or sea at any of the approved ports.
- Make sure your passport is valid for at least 180 days from your entry date.

This is based on policy data current as of 2026-08-17 — double-check evisa.gov.vn before you travel in case anything has changed.
